name: url
label: VictoriaMetrics URL
help:
The base URL that serves the Prometheus querying API, **without** the trailing `/api/v1`.

- Single-node: `http://<host>:8428`
- Cluster (vmselect): `http://<vmselect>:8481/select/<accountID>/prometheus`
- Behind vmauth or VictoriaMetrics Cloud: the URL your proxy exposes for queries

pattern.message: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://

fields.name: apiToken
fields.label: Bearer token
fields.help: Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` — for example a vmauth bearer token or a VictoriaMetrics Cloud access token with read access.

name: ignoreCertificateErrors
label: Ignore certificate errors
help: Enable when connecting to an instance with a self-signed certificate.

fields.name: indexingInfo
fields.content: Choose which label conventions are indexed as objects. Each pack runs a small `count by` query per object type.

fields.name: defaultCluster
fields.label: Default cluster name
fields.help: Cluster name to assume for series without a `cluster` or `k8s.cluster.name` label. Set this when some or all of your series don't carry a cluster label, so Kubernetes objects found under different label conventions merge, and drilldowns from query results resolve. Leave empty if every series carries a cluster label.

fields.name: indexK8s
fields.label: Kubernetes (standard labels)
fields.help: Index objects from the labels used by the common Kubernetes scrape configs, kube-state-metrics and cAdvisor, e.g. `namespace`, `pod`, `node`.

fields.name: indexOtelK8s
fields.label: Kubernetes (OpenTelemetry)
fields.help: Index objects from OpenTelemetry `k8s.*` resource attributes, e.g. `k8s.pod.name` or `k8s_pod_name`.

fields.name: indexOtelResource
fields.label: Services and hosts (OpenTelemetry)
fields.help: Index objects from OpenTelemetry resource attributes such as `service.name`, `host.name` and `deployment.environment.name`.

fields.name: indexOtelCloud
fields.label: Cloud resources (OpenTelemetry)
fields.help: Index objects from OpenTelemetry cloud resource attributes, e.g. `aws.eks.cluster.arn` or `gcp.gce.instance.hostname`.
